name: cx-box-carry
task: Carry the box to the exit, and whenever the box falls, pick it up again.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(at_exit) requires reaching the exit, Response(at_exit, holding_box) requires carrying the box at the exit, and Response(box_fell, holding_box) requires picking it up after each fall. The task's 'carry the box to the exit' and 'pick it up again' are each covered by a hard clause.

texts: When the agent reaches the exit, it is carrying the box.
Whenever the box falls, the agent picks it up again, so it is held on that step or later.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:

INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES: u3
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:

(u0, at_exit&!box_fell&!holding_box) -> u2
(u0, at_exit&!box_fell&holding_box) -> u3
(u0, at_exit&box_fell&!holding_box) -> u4
(u0, at_exit&box_fell&holding_box) -> u3
(u1, !at_exit&holding_box) -> u0
(u1, at_exit&!holding_box) -> u4
(u1, at_exit&holding_box) -> u3
(u2, !box_fell&holding_box) -> u3
(u2, box_fell&!holding_box) -> u4
(u2, box_fell&holding_box) -> u3
(u4, holding_box) -> u3
REWARD_FUNCTION:
